detail.reinstallDockerMessage: This runs Docker's official installer, which pulls the current engine — on an up-to-date server that is a major upgrade. Installing or upgrading Docker restarts the daemon, and that restarts every container on this server, including anything Openship is running here. Nothing else installs Docker for you: other steps skip it while it is working.

banner.unreachableBody: Openship couldn't open an SSH connection to {host}:{port}. Make sure the server is running and that sshd is accepting connections on port {port}. If it's behind a firewall or NAT, confirm the host is reachable from this machine.
banner.authBody: Reached {host}:{port} but the server refused authentication. The key or password stored for this server doesn't match what's authorised in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the host.
banner.noServerBody: This server entry is missing SSH settings. Open Edit to set the host, user and credentials, then run a health check.
banner.hostChannelTitle: Openship can't reach this machine's host
banner.hostChannelBody: Openship runs in a container here and talks to the host over SSH at {target}. Nothing answered there, so it can't run host-level operations on this box.
banner.hostChannelImpact: Ordinary deploys to this box still work — they go through the Docker socket. Blocked until the channel works: the host terminal, host system info and host port scans; taking over :80/:443 from a proxy Openship didn't start; installing or updating the mail engine; deploying a catalog app that needs a generated config file on the host (Supabase's kong.yml, say). This box also reads "Offline" in the dashboard's server list while the channel is down.
banner.hostChannelFix: Run this on the host, then retry:
banner.hostChannelMissingTitle: Openship has no channel to this machine's host
banner.hostChannelMissingBody: Openship runs in a container here, and the SSH channel it uses to reach the host was never provisioned. There was no address to contact, so nothing here is down — host-level operations on this box just have nowhere to run.
banner.hostChannelWouldUse: Once provisioned the channel will reach the host at {target}. Nothing has contacted that address yet.
banner.hostChannelProvisionFix: Run this on the host to provision the channel, then retry:
banner.hostChannelAuthBody: Openship runs in a container here and reaches the host over SSH at {target}. The host answered and then rejected the key, so host-level operations can't run. Either the key is no longer authorised for that account, or sshd doesn't permit that account to log in at all. The SSH credentials stored on this server are not used for this connection — the channel has its own key.
banner.hostChannelReauthorizeFix: Run this on the host to re-authorize the channel key, then retry:
banner.unknownBody: Openship couldn't talk to this server.
banner.checkPowered: Is the VPS / VM powered on?
banner.pingSuffix: from this machine - does it answer?
